summary: User requested real browser diagnosis and cross-platform end-to-end remediation, continuing the existing authorization to open PRs, require passing Actions and merge fixes.

Chrome UI reproduced separate-origin fixture failure: one attempted URL, zero saved responses, robots HTTP 0. Native transport fixes source read access without changing CORS or TLS protections. Live repaired Chrome UI saved four responses and explicitly reported one fixture 404. Five focused transport security tests and local Bandit passed. No actual intranet acceptance is claimed.

Full local regression gate passes: 78 Python, 18 station-hardening, 55 JavaScript tests. CLI help and compile pass. Native API security tests cover tokens, origin, redirect scope, station self-fetch, credentials and stop. Bandit with baseline passes.

Five real Chrome UI tests passed on macOS: non-CORS capture/export/offline navigation, 403 denial, robots selection, optional imported session, and pause/resume/stop with pending resources. Hosted Linux and macOS four-scenario suite passed at 1f1dc1d; expanded hosted suite and Windows remain pending. Full regression gate passes after lifecycle update.

Review fixes consume schema pacing bounds, forward safe request options and preserve redacted actual request metadata, add token-gated orphan recovery and a reload UI regression. Six UI tests pass on macOS arm64 Chrome 152.0.7977.76. Full gate: 80 Python, 18 station, 55 JavaScript passed. Conductor validation passed. Hosted suite uses installed Chrome after official runner inventories confirmed availability; platform results pending.

Hosted Windows UI acceptance exposed startup UnicodeEncodeError under cp1252 before serving began. Launcher now uses an ASCII banner and backslash replacement for unrepresentable diagnostics/paths. A cp1252 regression proves startup reaches serve_forever and closes cleanly. Eight focused bridge/launcher tests and full gate (81 Python, 18 station, 55 JavaScript) pass. Hosted final-head results pending.

Six browser acceptance scenarios passed on each hosted platform: Windows x64 Chrome 151.0.7922.174, Linux x64 Chrome 152.0.7977.64, macOS arm64 Chrome 152.0.7977.65. Local macOS Chrome 152.0.7977.76 also passed. AC1-AC5 satisfied for scoped synthetic acceptance; no private-site access claim.

Review findings fixed and resolved: pacing schema compatibility, actual request metadata, orphan-session recovery, workflow pins and Windows output encoding. Implementation acceptance complete. Final PR head must still pass all configured delivery checks before merge; this event does not claim merge or private-deployment acceptance.
